# Brandkit — Premium Brand Identity Image Skill for Muse

Turns Muse into a brand-identity art director: strategy first (category, audience, emotional promise, core metaphor), then a premium brand-kit overview image — default 3×3 grid covering logo cover, logo construction, digital application, tagline, color system, typography, physical application, image direction, and system detail. Ships logo-concept methods (monogram + meaning, product-action symbol, metaphor fusion, negative space, construction geometry), eight visual modes (dark developer, luxury, editorial, cultural, etc.), strict color discipline, and anti-generic rules.
